one_line: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, and marketing data.
api_surface: Broad, mature REST (and SOAP) API covering nearly all CRM objects; requires creating a 'Connected App' to get a Consumer Key/Secret, then OAuth2 flow for tokens.

one_line: CRM and marketing/sales/service platform with a broad public API.
api_surface: Broad REST API; Private App tokens are simplest (no expiry, single portal), OAuth2 required for apps installed across many portals/Marketplace listing.

one_line: Sales-pipeline-focused CRM with a developer-friendly REST API.
api_surface: REST API v1/v2, resource-based (/deals, /persons, /organizations); free developer account available; simple static API token for internal use, OAuth2 required only for public Marketplace apps.

one_line: Modern, data-model-flexible CRM with REST API and OAuth-based MCP.
api_surface: Public REST API with published OpenAPI spec; official MCP server exists with OAuth-based user-scoped auth for agent-driven workflows.
